overal.goal: Webhooks can only be created, listed and deleted. Add a webhook update operation (REST, MCP and the web UI) that enables, disables and edits a webhook (url, events, projects) without recreating it, so the signing secret and delivery history survive. Also allow underscores in event names: runner.budget_exceeded is a real event, but patterns and validation treat the underscore as unknown. Found while building the phase 5 Automation page (2026-11-02).
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono, zod, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md, docs/boof-runner.md and docs/api.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Filed with phase 5 of the UI redesign (2026-11-02); not started.

Shipped: PUT /webhooks/{id} (enable, disable, edit url, events and projects; REST only, like the other webhook operations) with every rule of create (URL guard, event names, reach and review-trust limits, empty project list refused) and a secret and creator that never change; underscores allowed in event names; the Automation page can enable, disable and edit.

tests.strategy: API tests: update enable, disable and edit of a webhook keeps its secret; an event pattern with an underscore (runner.budget_exceeded) is accepted; unknown events are still refused; non-admin keys are refused.
